Drop element writes nothing for an inline data image

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"inline_data_media\":\"DropElement\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Before <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"icon\"> after</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
